reasons.not_a_person: Only a person can lead or help on a task. An agent acts for its person.
reasons.office_no_stage: An office task belongs to no project, so it has no stage.
reasons.office_no_prerequisites: An office task does not wait for other tasks.
reasons.review_by_maker: The person who made this task reviews it. A task that this person leads needs no review.
reasons.file_office_task: A file of an office task stays on its task.
reasons.office_needs_task: Choose the project or the office task of this file.
